title: Geometric Diagnostics of Scrambling-Related Sensitivity in a Bohmian Preparation Space
summary: The Out-of-Time-Order Correlator (OTOC) is a standard algebraic diagnostic of quantum information scrambling, but it offers limited direct geometric intuition. In this note, we propose a Bohmian, trajectory-based framework for constructing a geometric diagnostic of scrambling-related sensitivity using Lagrangian Descriptors (LDs).
